On August 28, 2024, police were called to investigate suspicious bags discovered near an event center in La Crosse, WI, just a day before a scheduled rally by former President Donald Trump. The bags had been hidden in bushes outside the building and the person who found them initially thought little of them. However, upon examining the bags, the individual uncovered something deeply concerning.
